title: Tenant Verification and Gray Release
goal: Run hostile two-tenant verification, migration/rollback rehearsal, performance and observability checks, then decide controlled pilot or blocked release.
statusNote: 2026-09-15 update: hostile two-tenant browser matrix expanded and executed against the live local runtime (rebuilt backend with S3 download authorization + smoke vite + MySQL/Redis). New spec tests/smoke-core/tenant-hostile-browser-matrix.spec.ts adds 5 scenarios previously un-covered in browser: live multi-mode login picker (candidates disclosed only after password verification, session hint/cookies empty pre-selection), wrong-password candidate suppression, per-tenant dashboard render without page errors, refresh rotation + replay rejection + old access-session revocation, real upload API landing under t101/ namespace with foreign-namespace and traversal probes rejected. Multi-mode run 6/6 passed (incl. existing protected-resources spec), compat flag-off regression auth-login-logout 4/4 passed; flag restored to compat and matrix dict fixtures removed afterwards. Evidence: artifacts/browser/tenant-hostile-browser-matrix-20260915.json. G1-G4 human gates, production-like rollback/cache invalidation, S3-backed runtime probe (local driver exercised), performance/observability and production recovery remain open; final release recommendation remains blocked. Earlier 2026-09-14 scope: local executable verification passed (go test -short, hostile middleware matrix, concurrent tenant-boundary, DB-backed tenant packages, Playwright smoke 7/7 + 1/1, visual baselines 3/3, HTTP tenant runtime matrix 23/23, logout defect fixed via Redis access-session deletion + TokenAuth cache invalidation).
legacyStatusNote: 2026-09-14: local executable verification scope passed and is evidenced: backend go test -short ./..., hostile two-tenant middleware matrix, concurrent tenant-boundary test, tenant-sensitive auth/data packages, frontend type-check, frontend lint, git diff --check, auth plus tenant-picker Playwright smoke 7/7, protected-resource Playwright smoke 1/1, login visual baselines 3/3, and the rebuilt-backend local MySQL/Redis HTTP tenant runtime matrix 23/23. The protected-resource browser test covers independent tenant contexts, dashboard/dictionary page access, dictionary list isolation, export isolation, cross-tenant ID update rejection, and cross-tenant batch-status rejection. The matrix covered compat -> multi -> compat, stale token/header forgery, dictionary list/export, ID tamper, refresh rotation/replay, audit/file isolation, logout access-token revocation, and kill-switch force expiry; temporary dictionary fixtures and the blacklist were removed, the flag was restored to compat, and reusable smoke tenants 101/202 were retained. A logout defect was fixed by deleting the current Redis access session and invalidating the TokenAuth middleware cache. Full browser coverage for all protected resources, production-like rollback/cache invalidation, S3 authorization, durable jobs, performance/observability, production recovery, and human G1-G4 gates remain open. Dashboard and system-user-list visual baselines still differ by approximately 2% and were not updated. Race testing is blocked by Windows CGO_ENABLED=0. Final release recommendation remains blocked.
